offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures differentiated electronic instruments, sensors, analytical and test equipment, and engineered electromechanical components. Sells to industrial, aerospace, defense, medical, power and process customers worldwide, largely through direct sales, and grows by acquiring niche businesses.

primary_products.value: analytical and process instruments; test and measurement instruments; aerospace and defense sensors and avionics; electromechanical motors and connectors; thermal management systems

primary_services.value: calibration and repair; aftermarket maintenance and support

customer_segment.value: B2B: aerospace, industrial, medical, semiconductor, power, process and research manufacturers and OEMs; B2G: defense agencies and military programs

end_markets.value: aerospace and defense; industrial automation; medical; power and energy; process industries; semiconductor and electronics

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments, sensors, motors and components sold to OEMs and end users; service fees: calibration, repair and aftermarket support

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds instruments and electromechanical products from purchased materials, sold to industrial and aerospace customers; component supplier: supplies motors, sensors and connectors to equipment makers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: Electronic Instruments Group and Electromechanical Group, both niche instruments and components

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales force selling to OEMs and end users; distributors / dealers: independent distributors and sales representatives

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: aerospace and defense export controls (ITAR), product safety and environmental rules
